After no progress for some time it was decided to rack back the stand & pick up wild single to have more room to work the string. Overpull and resistance ware seen while reaming up & down. And up to 60 klbs additional weight had to be used to push & pull the BHA past the ledge. The area was reamed few times before dril

rameters used for most of the well were 520gpm, 180rpm, 15-30klbs giving rate of penetration ranging from 160-180ft/hr. We started to pump OOH with 200gpm after the hole had been circulated times bottoms up. At 16510ft 80- 90klbs overpull was taken, The flow rate was increased to 500gpm and with 140rpm the interval was reamed through observing 12-28kftlb torque; ran back down and pumped through without any overpull.
